scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development SMS_TRANSPORT=test && pnpm run build && node --enable-source-maps ./dist/index.mjs
scripts.test: JWT_SECRET=test-secret ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://test.example esbuild src/error-boundary.test.ts src/lib/sms.test.ts src/lib/financialAllocation.test.ts src/lib/commissionSettlements.test.ts src/lib/geo.test.ts src/routes/hq/apiConnections.test.ts src/routes/hq/pharmacies.test.ts src/routes/pharmacy/inventory.test.ts src/lib/secrets.test.ts src/lib/security.test.ts src/lib/staticSites.test.ts src/lib/storage/sigv4.test.ts src/lib/storage/objectStorage.test.ts src/routes/hq/pilotResetPlan.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:pg-native --outdir=dist/tests --out-extension:.js=.cjs --log-level=warning && NODE_ENV=production LOG_LEVEL=silent JWT_SECRET=test-secret ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://test.example node --test $(find dist/tests -name '*.test.cjs' -type f)
scripts.test-patient-flow: pnpm --filter @workspace/db exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild scripts/test-patient-flow.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:pg-native --outfile=dist/test-patient-flow.cjs --log-level=warning && node dist/test-patient-flow.cjs
scripts.test-order-concurrency: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && esbuild scripts/test-order-concurrency.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:pg-native --outfile=dist/test-order-concurrency.cjs --log-level=warning && node dist/test-order-concurrency.cjs
scripts.verify-orange-sms: esbuild scripts/verify-orange-sms.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/verify-orange-sms.cjs --log-level=warning && NODE_ENV=production SMS_TRANSPORT=orange node dist/verify-orange-sms.cjs
